title: Show public resolution, operational profiles and imperfect evidence in sheets
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement demand-opened glass sheets for public player operational details, event feed/evidence and Resolution/Anomaly. Render the authoritative incident outcome and persistent consequence without treating repair/sabotage as alignment proof. Trace Online may reveal only safe/corrupted/mixed pair classification after unlock, never which operator selected what. Audit Window result is rendered only for the entitled recipient and reports safe/corrupted/neutral/timeout without a faction label. I03 redaction is retained rather than reconstructed client-side. No stringify/spread of raw engine events; explicit allowed text/icon fields and public operational/cooldown status only. Declare this presentation module readonly props locally from the documented fields and accept injected callbacks/asset lookups; do not import an unfinished server implementation. A035/A048 adapt canonical production DTOs and parsed intents into these props. The canonical producer contracts are A025 observeMatchV1/getLegalActionsV1 and A056 versioned recipient DTOs (A067 projects multiplayer views); public/private/legal fields must originate there, never raw hidden MatchStateV1. A004 owns exact I01–I06 option labels and all36 semantic icon keys.
acceptance: Resolution and evidence match supplied public/recipient fields with meaningful empty, redacted and waiting states.
Extra secret fields, individual operation choices, seed and other roles never reach public feed/profile DOM or labels.
Trace Online and Audit Window preserve their different disclosure levels and never prove a secret alignment.
Sheets lock the full game background, preserve focus and render names/scenarios as escaped text.
designSections: SCREEN-FLOW: 8. Match, 10. Resolution / Anomaly; RULES-SPEC-v1: Track moments and powers
